purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer/service inspection, bounded anonymous requests, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Serra's official GeoSerra portal is a current municipal map service. Its BaseMap_SerraES ArcGIS REST service exposes three Parcelamento de Solo polygon layers (IDs 213, 208, 203), but all tested anonymous queries returned ArcGIS error 500. No parcel geometry was retained.
registryAssessment: A local municipal geospatial custodian is evidenced by Serra's official GeoSerra publication and service description. registryFound remains null because the evidence does not establish a successfully queryable public cadastral registry response or a qualifying parcel record.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Serra em Mapas/GeoSerra portal entry point.
Official ArcGIS MapServer metadata lists Parcelamento de Solo layers 213, 208, and 203.
Official layer metadata identifies a polygon Parcelamento de Solo layer; description says lot layers are divided by district for compatibility/performance with the former CTM-Geo system.
Municipal service description identifies the map portal as a municipal cartographic-information WebGIS and names the municipal geoprocessing department.
Official municipal announcement describes GeoSerra 2.1 and says the map includes lots and buildings.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: ArcGIS Portal/REST; official announcement says GeoSerra 2.1 uses ArcGIS Experience Builder.
viewerConfiguration.sourceFieldMapping: Layer 213 metadata exposed OBJECTID and cadastral/lot-label fields. No field was accepted as a retained stable native parcel identity because no feature response was obtained; the other fields were not retained as data.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying anonymous parcel feature response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: Exact-point and bounded/nonspatial ArcGIS queries were attempted against first-party layers and all returned ArcGIS error 500.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Serra municipal GeoSerra portal and official BaseMap_SerraES service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Service and layer metadata only; no successful feature response.

uncertainty: ArcGIS query failures may reflect current service configuration, source/database failure, request incompatibility, or access policy. They do not establish citywide absence. The exact WUP point was used without shifting.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-complete-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
